The town of
'
Aliabad
(
علی‌آباد
) is the center of
Ali abad District
in
Kunduz Province
, Northern
Afghanistan
. It is situated in the central part of the district at 425 m altitude on the main road between
Kunduz
and
Baghlan
. Aliabad has one hospital and is located in an area of rainfed cropland. The town is located on the
Kunduz River
.
[
1
]
[
2
]
On 12 June 2021, Taliban forces captured the village as part of their
nationwide military offensive
.
